title: 第232章  北林血战
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

北侧林道，阴雾翻滚。

尸潮涌来的瞬间，山林像被一只黑色巨手按住，连风声都变得沉闷。

灰袍老人手中黑幡一卷，几十具尸虫傀同时扑出。

它们不是杂乱冲锋，而是分作三层。

前排伏地疾行，专攻腿脚。

中排直扑上身，利爪带着尸毒。

后排则张口吐出黑色虫雾，试图先污染宋青山的真气。

显然，灰袍老人已经研究过宋青山的打法。

硬碰硬，他挡不住至阳真气。

所以他要耗。

用尸傀耗宋青山的气，用虫毒耗沈冰心的药，用山坳外的阴雾耗他们的心神。

宋青山一剑斩出。

金色剑光贴着地面横扫，前排尸虫傀的尸虫核心同时爆开。

焦臭味冲起。

沈冰心紧随其后，药粉如雾，压住尸虫傀炸开后的黑毒。

她动作极稳，没有多浪费半点药力。

灰袍老人冷笑。

“宋青山，你今日敲了三门钟，还敢这么用至阳真气？”

宋青山没有回答。

他身形一转，剑锋划过第二排尸傀脖颈。

三颗头颅飞起。

头颅还未落地，里面藏着的尸虫便想钻出。

沈冰心袖中银针飞射，将三只尸虫钉死在半空。

宋青山这才淡淡道：“杀你够用。”

灰袍老人眼神一沉。

黑幡再次卷动。

更多尸傀从林雾里爬出。

沈冰心看了一眼四周，低声道：“他在拖你。”

宋青山道：“我知道。”

沈冰心道：“不能被他拖住。”

宋青山点头。

他当然知道。

黑先生就在倒井山坳。

井心封印已经裂开。

灰袍老人守在这里，不是为了杀他，而是为了让他迟到。

迟到一刻，井心那边就多一分变数。

宋青山忽然收剑。

沈冰心眼神一动。

她知道宋青山要变招。

下一刻，宋青山左手结印，右手剑锋指地。

玄阴柔劲先行铺开。

不是攻击。

而是如水一般渗入林道泥土，沿着尸傀脚下扩散。

灰袍老人皱眉。

“玄阴柔劲？”

他知道宋青山有阴阳两种劲力，却不明白此刻用玄阴柔劲有什么意义。

尸傀本就属阴。

用阴劲，岂不是助长尸气？

但很快，他脸色变了。

玄阴柔劲不是在增强尸傀，而是在“引”。

那些尸虫傀体内的尸煞，被柔劲牵动，短暂偏离核心。

就在这一瞬，宋青山剑锋抬起。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the forest road on the north side, mist rolled in.

The moment the corpse wave came in, the mountain forest seemed to be held down by a giant black hand, and even the sound of the wind became dull.

The gray-robed old man held a black flag in his hand, and dozens of corpse insect puppets rushed out at the same time.

Instead of charging in disarray, they are divided into three layers.

The front row moves quickly while lying on the ground, focusing on the legs and feet.

The middle row pounced straight on the upper body, its sharp claws carrying corpse poison.

The people in the back row spat out black insect mist, trying to contaminate Song Qingshan's true energy first.

Obviously, the old man in gray robe has studied Song Qingshan's fighting style.

Face to face, he couldn't stop Zhiyang Zhenqi.

So he wants to consume.

Use corpse puppets to drain Song Qingshan's energy, use insect poison to drain Shen Bingxin's medicine, and use the mist outside the mountain col to drain their minds.

Song Qingshan slashed out with his sword.

The golden sword light swept across the ground, and the zombie cores of the zombie puppets in the front row exploded at the same time.

The smell of burning arose.

Shen Bingxin followed closely behind, the medicinal powder was like mist, suppressing the black poison after the zombie puppet exploded.

Her movements were very steady and she didn't waste any more medicine.

The old man in gray robe sneered.

"Song Qingshan, you have rung three bells today, how dare you use Zhiyang Qi like this?"

Song Qingshan did not answer.

He turned around and the sword edge passed through the necks of the second row of zombies.

Three heads flew up.

Before the head even hit the ground, the corpse insect hidden inside wanted to get out.

The silver needle in Shen Bingxin's sleeve flew out, nailing the three corpse insects to death in mid-air.

Song Qingshan then said calmly: "Killing you is enough."

The gray-robed old man's eyes darkened.

The black flag rolled again.

More zombies crawled out of the forest mist.

Shen Bingxin glanced around and whispered: "He is dragging you."

Song Qingshan said: "I know."

Shen Bing thought: "We can't be held back by him."

Song Qingshan nodded.

Of course he knows.

Mr. Hei is in Daojingshan Col.

The seal at the center of the well has cracked.

The old man in gray robe is guarding here, not to kill him, but to make him late.

If you are a moment late, there will be one more variable in the center of the well.

Song Qingshan suddenly sheathed his sword.

Shen Bingxin's eyes moved.

She knew that Song Qingshan was going to change his tactics.

The next moment, Song Qingshan formed a seal with his left hand and pointed the sword edge of his right hand at the ground.

Xuan Yin's soft energy spreads out first.

Not an attack.

Instead, it seeped into the forest road soil like water and spread along the corpse's feet.

The old man in gray robe frowned.

"Xuanyin Roujin?"

He knew that Song Qingshan had both yin and yang powers, but he didn't understand the meaning of using Xuan Yin's soft power at this moment.

Corpse puppets are inherently Yin.

Wouldn't using Yin energy encourage corpse energy?

But soon, his expression changed.

Xuanyin Roujin is not strengthening the corpse puppet, but "leading" it.

The corpse evil in those corpse insect puppets was affected by the soft energy and temporarily deviated from the core.

At this moment, Song Qingshan raised his sword.
